summary: Humacyte filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten follow-on offering of common stock. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The company is offering shares on Nasdaq under symbol HUMA, with Barclays, BTIG, and Titan Partners as joint book-running managers. The last reported sale price on June 9, 2026 was $1.39 per share. The offering size and price are not yet set, as the prospectus remains subject to completion. No special-situation characteristics are present; this is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
